travels.title: Japan 360°: Tokyo, Kyoto, Hiroshima & Osaka by Bullet Train
travels.shortDescription: The classic highlights of Japan: dive into the buzz of Tokyo, find peace among the temples and bamboo forest of Kyoto, and complete the journey by exploring the wonders of Hiroshima, Osaka, and Nara.
travels.description:
Any great trip to Japan should include some unmissable stops and, great news, we have them all covered: Tokyo, the frenetic modern capital; Kyoto, with its temples and historic neighbourhoods; Hiroshima, reborn after the Second World War; and Osaka, home of Japanese cuisine.
Modern meets tradition: in Tokyo we cross the busiest intersection in the world among skyscrapers, while in Kamakura we find the peace of Buddhist temples and Zen gardens, not far from the iconic Mount Fuji. The Shinkansen, the high-speed train with a reputation for never being late, takes us to Kyoto, its majestic temples, the bamboo forest and the traditional red gates of Fushimi Inari. Then a jump back in time in Hiroshima, Osaka and Himeji Castle, before Nara and its famous deer walking freely in the city park. A culture far from ours, waiting to be uncovered: are you ready?

travels.title: Morocco Express: Marrakech, Essaouira & a Desert Sunrise
travels.shortDescription: The essence of Morocco in 5 days: explore the vibrant culture of Marrakech, sleep under the stars in the Agafay Desert, then unwind on the Atlantic coast of Essaouira.
travels.description:
This five-day express tour is the perfect way to experience the best of Morocco in a short time: rich cultural heritage, diverse landscapes and warm hospitality in an enchanting country that has been fascinating travellers for centuries. We start in the vibrant, bustling streets of Marrakech, with its ancient medina and colorful souks, where the traditional way of life has remained unchanged for centuries.
Then we get a taste of desert life in the Agafay Desert: a night in a tented camp and a Bedouin dinner under the stars, a true desert experience you'll never forget. Next we move to the Atlantic coast and the charming town of Essaouira, known for its laid-back vibe and beautiful beaches. And the sunset? Not to be missed!

travels.title: China 360°: Beijing, Shanghai, the Great Wall & Chengdu's Giant Pandas
travels.shortDescription: A short but not exhaustive list of what you’ll see on this trip to China? The Great Wall, the Avatar Mountains, pandas in Chengdu, the villages of Furong, Tianmen Mountain, the Terracotta Army, Beijing, and Shanghai. Quite a lot, indeed.
travels.description:
Ready for an epic adventure in China? We explore the wonders of a thousand-year-old country, from avant-garde metropolises where skyscrapers stand alongside ancient traditional buildings to its most stunning natural landscapes. It starts in Beijing, with its ancient temples, the Forbidden City and Tiananmen Square, and continues on the Great Wall, the quintessential symbol of the ancient empire, a stone serpent stretching for thousands of kilometers.
Next come the immense Terracotta Army, the friendly giant pandas of Chengdu in their nature reserves, and traditional villages like Furong, where time seems to stand still and we glimpse the daily lives of Chinese farmers. We walk among the rock spires of the Zhangjiajie Mountains, the inspiration for the movie Avatar, before ending in Shanghai, a modern metropolis that gazes toward the future.

travels.title: Geneva & Annecy Weekend: Chocolatiers and Pearls of the Alps
travels.description:
A weekend blending the cosmopolitan elegance of Geneva with the fairytale charm of Annecy, where the snow-capped Alps reflect in crystal-clear lakes. This itinerary will lead us to discover two alpine gems through authentic experiences that stimulate your senses: from the intense aroma of Geneva's historic chocolateries to the irresistible scent of creperies along the canals.
We'll start in cosmopolitan Geneva, navigating on the iconic Mouettes that skim the lake's waters. We'll get lost in the cobbled streets of the old town, admire the famous Jet d'Eau, and discover the artisan Swiss chocolate shops - true institutions of tradition where every praline tells a story of excellence.
Crossing the French border, Annecy will welcome us with its timeless charm: pastel-colored houses overlooking the canals, flowery bridges, and the picturesque Palais de l'Île emerging from the turquoise water as if from an old-fashioned postcard. From Annecy Castle, you'll enjoy breathtaking views of one of Europe's purest lakes, before savoring a gourmet crêpe included in the tour, while sitting by the canals in the historic center.
Ready to go? We'll experience an unforgettable weekend of alpine panoramas, sweet temptations, and enchanting canals!

travels.title: Egypt 360°: Pyramids of Giza, Night Train to Aswan & the Red Sea
travels.shortDescription: Get ready for an epic adventure: in Egypt, you’ll walk among majestic pyramids, legendary temples, and pharaohs' tombs, from Giza to Abu Simbel, all the way to the Valley of the Kings. And after so much history… a well-deserved relaxation awaits you in the dreamlike sea of Hurghada.
travels.description:
A trip to Egypt is a journey back in time to one of the world's oldest civilisations: a desert land made rich and fertile by the Nile River, where the kingdom of Ancient Egypt thrived. Our group adventure begins in Cairo, where the Pyramids of Giza and the Sphinx tower over the modern skyline. Heading south, we uncover ancient tombs, monuments and necropolises preserved by rock and sand, surviving wars, looting and abandonment.
In Aswan we stand in awe of the Ramses statues at Abu Simbel, while in Luxor we delve into the Karnak temple complex and the Valley of the Kings, the resting place of Egypt's rulers. Before heading back to Cairo, we enjoy 24 hours of well-deserved relaxation in the crystal-clear waters of Hurghada. We'll feel like little Indiana Joneses: this time, history isn't learned from books, it's explored firsthand!

travels.title: Vietnam 360°: from Hanoi to Ho Chi Minh City
travels.shortDescription: Vietnam from north to south: lose yourself in Hanoi’s Old Quarter, discover the rice fields of Ninh Binh and be left breathless in Ha Long Bay. And then? An overnight train to Hue, the magic of Hoi An, the modern vibes of Ho Chi Minh city.
travels.description:
If you want to discover South-East Asia, Vietnam is the place to start! The nature is beautiful and diverse, cities are crowded and hectic just like you imagine any city in Asia should be and people are the most smiling and welcoming ever!
We start our group trip in the capital in Hanoi and then head off to explore the north, with the rice fields of Pu Luong, the pagodas in Ninh Binh and the magical Ha Long Bay. We continue our journey by travelling south, first reaching Hue and Hoi An by train (the local one!), then arriving in Ho Chi Minh City and maybe making a trip even further south to the Mekong Delta. A journey from North to South, discovering one of the most fascinating countries ever. Ready to enjoy every single moment of this incredible adventure?

travels.title: Kyrgyzstan 360°: Bishkek, Yurt Nights & Eagle Hunters of Central Asia
travels.shortDescription: Kyrgyzstan is wild and spectacular: sleep in yurts under endless skies, ride through endless mountains, explore Martian canyons, and reach hidden lakes. Here, you don’t take a trip: you live an adventure that changes you forever.
travels.description:
Why settle for the usual trip when you can embark on a once-in-a-lifetime expedition in the untouched wilderness of Kyrgyzstan? Imagine waking up in a traditional yurt below snow-capped mountains. Every day means boundless pastures, pure air, rich traditions and eagles soaring!
We start in Bishkek, where Russian influences in architecture quickly give way to the wild on the road to Lake Issyk Kul, Konorchek Canyon and Burana Tower. Then the surreal Skazka Canyon, Jeti Oguz Valley and an eagle hunting demonstration. At Lake Song Kul, a horseback expedition awaits. We visit the historic Tash Rabat Caravanserai and reach the remote Ak Sai Valley at the China border, below the Kakshaal Too range. One last trek to Köl Suu Lake's breathtaking landscapes, then a final night together in Bishkek. That’s the essence of a WeRoad expedition.

travels.title: Iceland: Hunting the Northern Lights
travels.shortDescription: Explore Iceland's winter wonders: from Reykjavik to the Snæfellsnes Peninsula, from the Golden Circle all the way to the black sand beach. The real magic? The Northern Lights – yes, we'll be chasing them every night!
travels.description: Iceland in eight winter days, self-drive, with the Northern Lights chased every night between November and March. From Reykjavik we take 4x4s out to the Snaefellsnes Peninsula and Kirkjufell, the Golden Circle at Geysir and Gullfoss, then the south coast: the Solheimajokull glacier hike, the black sand of Reynisfjara, Jokulsarlon lagoon where Vatnajokull calves icebergs, Skogafoss, Seljalandsfoss and the DC-3 wreck, and Kerid crater on the way back. Downtime is thermal water, at the Secret Lagoon and Laugarás Lagoon, plus Reykjavik's centre and nightlife at the end. Mostly nature and driving, and an aurora hunt that stays unpredictable.

travels.shortDescription: An 8-day journey to discover Albania, starting from the capital Tirana and heading south, passing through traditional villages and enchanted nature, all the way to the beaches of Saranda to enjoy the sea.

We cross Lake Koman by speed boat to the Shala River, drive to Berat, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, then reach the beaches of Himara and the Pirate's Cave by private boat. Further south sit Butrint, from the Greek era, and Ali Pasha Castle, before two nights of sea and nightlife in Saranda. The way home offers Apollonia or rafting on the Vjosa River. Half culture, half beach and downtime.

travels.title: Sweden: Northern Lights and Lapland
travels.shortDescription: Chase and capture the magic of the Northern Lights beyond the Arctic Circle. Depart from Stockholm to Kiruna on an overnight train. Upon arrival, we’re greeted by husky sled rides, snowmobile tours, and hot saunas under the Northern sky.
travels.description: Seven days in Swedish Lapland: Stockholm, then a night train beyond the Arctic Circle to Kiruna, the country's northernmost town. The capital brings 14 islands, Djurgården, the Vasa Museum and Skansen; then more than a thousand kilometres of track north, where winter means almost 24 hours of darkness, no light pollution and a real chance of photographing the Northern Lights. Up there: husky sledding, snowmobiles, a reindeer farm, a Sami village, the Ice Hotel, a day trip to Abisko National Park on foot, snowshoes or cross-country skis, and downtime with saunas, fika and a cabin dinner.

travels.shortDescription: Discover Athens, the most cosmopolitan city in Europe. Explore its historic center, the majestic Acropolis, and the Parthenon with a local guide, immersing yourself in the true essence of Greece. We believe you’ll fall in love and yes, you’ll probably want to come back.
travels.description: This Athens weekend gives us three days in the most cosmopolitan city in Europe, all together in true WeRoad style, chasing the authentic Greek soul. We savour local flavours with a refined tasting of typical wines and dishes in charming traditional taverns, then get lost in the centre of Athens and its stunning Acropolis, with the magnificent Parthenon watching over the city. A local guide takes us back into ancient Greece, the cradle of our civilisation. We also reach the majestic Temple of Poseidon at Cape Sounion, by the sea, for a breathtaking sunset. And we say goodbye strolling through Athens' most vintage and authentic neighbourhoods, where the real local culture still runs on tradition, energy and pure wonder.

travels.title: Costa Rica 360°: between jungle, beaches and volcanoes
travels.shortDescription: Costa Rica, baby! Between jungle trails, dream waterfalls, and mangrove forests by kayak, you’ll meet sloths, monkeys, and a bit of pura vida. Relax, explore, and discover that living to the Tico rhythm is contagious!
travels.description:
Welcome to Costa Rica, it's time to enjoy some pura vida and wind down and get lost in this corner of paradise! Get ready to hike trails that lead to waterfalls in the jungle, explore mangrove forests by kayak, encounter the most diverse wildlife and learn to recognise its sounds. On our tour of Costa Rica, you will finally get back to what life should be, so when it's eventually time to say goodbye to this incredible country, you will take a little bit of their lifestyle home with you.
Our trip starts in San José but don't worry, we leave the city right away: on day 2 we are already on the road to the sea in Puerto Viejo. Here we enjoy the Caribbean, exploring the surroundings by bicycle and taking our first swim of the trip! Then it's all nature: we go into Tortuguero National Park, where we trek and kayak among the mangroves, and, if the season is right, we'll see turtles hatch! Can we then miss a fair dose of adrenaline? Here we go then with some rafting on the Rio Sarapiquí and in Monteverde we'll explore the rainforest by zipline - but first we'll also make a stop in Arenal Volcano National Park, where the landscape is dominated by the cone of the majestic volcano. Finally, we reach Uvita, on the Pacific coast, where days of relaxation, yoga on the beach, long sunset walks and lots of snorkelling await! We end our trip with one last national park, Manuel Antonio National Park, where we will have our last full immersion in nature before returning to civilization in San José, where it all began. After this trip, 'Pura Vida' will be our new motto, and we will return home with new awareness of the natural world.

travels.title: Strasbourg and Colmar Express: the magic of Christmas markets, fine wines, and relaxation
travels.shortDescription: In Alsace, Christmas is like a movie: from Strasbourg to Colmar to Riquewihr, with lights, markets, mulled wine, and the Wine Route. We end in a spa, toasting to the most magical (and calorie-filled) Christmas ever, WeRoad style.
travels.description:
Christmas in Alsace is nothing short of magical – a journey through festive markets, historic towns, and unforgettable flavours. Picture yourself in a cosy Christmas jumper, wandering beneath twinkling lights, and warming your hands with a glass of mulled wine by the fire.
We begin in Strasbourg, proudly known as the Capital of Christmas, with its enchanting old town and unique festive atmosphere. From there, we continue to Colmar, the romantic heart of Alsatian wine country, which transforms into a fairytale village during the Christmas season.
Along the way, we’ll visit Riquewihr, a medieval gem said to have inspired Disney’s Beauty and the Beast. Here, among half-timbered houses and artisan workshops, you can soak up the authentic charm of Alsace. Our route follows the famous Route des Vins, winding past medieval castles, historic buildings, and snow-dusted vineyards, where we’ll savour traditional cheeses and fine local wines.
To complete the experience, we’ll enjoy a cruise along the Rhine aboard a Batorama, or unwind in a traditional Alsatian spa. This Christmas tour through Alsace combines culture, gastronomy, and breathtaking scenery – the perfect way to celebrate the festive season in a place where Christmas magic truly comes alive.

travels.description: Bali 360° circles the most famous island in all of Indonesia in eight days. We start in Seminyak, move inland to Jatiluwih, the UNESCO rice terraces, and to Pura Ulun Danu Bratan on Lake Bratan. We ride Bali's famous swings at Wanagiri Hill, cook in a village kitchen and get up at 2am for the sunrise over Mount Batur and Lake Batur. Then Ubud, the beating heart of the island: temples, rice fields, palaces, the Monkey Forest and local restaurants with vegetarian and vegan dishes, before Kuta and Seminyak close the circle with beach time.

travels.title: Maldives Beach Life: Dolphins, Turtles & Sunset Sandbanks in Vaavu Atoll
travels.shortDescription: Fulidhoo and the Vaavu Atoll await you for 7 days of adventure in the Maldives! Swim in a dream sea with nurse sharks, walk among giant rays, and explore underwater treasures. Swimsuit and sunscreen: the rest is magic, and you’ll find it there!
travels.description:
Experience a once-in-a-lifetime adventure in the Maldives, where each island is a unique world. Despite their small size, the inhabitants thrive under the law of the sea, surrounded by stunning landscapes that seem straight out of a dream. From sunrise to sunset, you'll feel like you're living in a postcard—but it's all real. Join us on a 7-day journey to explore Fulidhoo Island and the Vaavu Atoll.
On this exclusive group trip, we'll uncover uninhabited islands and hidden underwater treasures. Our home base will be the enchanting Vaavu Atoll, centered around the idyllic Fulidhoo. Here, you'll relax on powdery white sand beaches under the shade of swaying palms, but that's just the beginning. Dive into crystal-clear waters, stroll along shores alongside majestic giant stingrays, and discover vibrant marine life through diving and snorkeling. Unwind on remote sandbanks that feel like your private paradise and revel in the underwater wonders of the coral reef.
This isn't just a vacation—it's a bucket list adventure everyone dreams of. Prepare for days filled with nothing but swimsuits, flip-flops, and the gentle reminder to reapply sunscreen. With endless opportunities for exploration and relaxation, your only worry will be soaking in every incredible moment of this Maldivian paradise.

travels.title: Transylvania Express: On the road in the land of Count Dracula
travels.shortDescription: A trip through Transylvania, from Bucharest to the castles of Peleș and Bran (yes, Dracula’s castle!), the Bear Sanctuary, and the Turda Salt Mine. And there’s so much more… but we don’t want to spoil the surprise!
travels.description:
Transylvania is more than just Dracula - it's a land of fairy-tale castles, medieval towns, lush forests, and warm hospitality. Our journey starts in Bucharest and takes us through some of Romania’s most iconic spots: the royal Peles Castle, the legendary Bran Castle (aka Dracula’s Castle), and the charming medieval cities of Brasov, Sighișoara, and Sibiu.
We’ll explore fortified villages, visit Europe’s largest bear sanctuary, and descend into the surreal underground world of Salina Turda. Along the way: hearty food, local folklore, and even a drive on the breathtaking Transfăgărășan Highway.
This is a road trip packed with nature, history, and adventure - Transylvania like you've never seen it before.

Together, we’ll discover Playa del Carmen and its golden beaches and snorkel among the Caribbean’s coral reefs in Tulum, in places that feel almost unreal, where nature and history blend seamlessly. Our journey runs through the heart of Mayan civilisation, between ancient pyramids and hidden temples, before ending in Cancún, a modern city known for its beaches, energy and nightlife.

travels.shortDescription: The beauties of Peru in a single journey: from Lima to Huacachina, the Colca Canyon, Lake Titicaca, trekking at Rainbow Mountain, Arequipa, Cuzco, and of course, Machu Picchu. One of those “once-in-a-lifetime” adventures.
travels.description:
Peru is a country of extraordinary landscapes and ancient civilisations, and this itinerary is designed to take us deep into its history and natural beauty. From Inca cities and dramatic canyons to the floating islands of Lake Titicaca, each stop reveals a different side of the country.
Starting in Lima, we travel inland to the Colca Canyon, one of the deepest canyons in the world, where condors soar above the peaks. We continue to Chivay before reaching Lake Titicaca, where we’ll meet local communities and learn about their traditions.
The journey then takes us to high altitude for a trek on Rainbow Mountain, followed by the Sacred Valley and the iconic archaeological site of Machu Picchu. We return to Lima at the end of the trip, bringing with us a collection of unforgettable experiences.

travels.title: Copenhagen Weekend: Fairytale Charm, Tivoli Gardens & Danish Hygge
travels.shortDescription: A weekend in Copenhagen: from the Little Mermaid to Tivoli Gardens, plus a boat tour through the city’s charming canals.
travels.description:
This Copenhagen weekend packs three days into the Danish capital, moving between historic neighborhoods, picturesque canals, elegant squares and one very famous amusement park. We arrive in the early afternoon on day one, tour Rosenborg Castle, stop by the canals for a Danish snack and sit down to a traditional Danish dinner. Day two is a Walking Tour with a local guide, from the Little Mermaid through Nyhavn and Stroget, then a long afternoon inside Tivoli Gardens. 
On the last morning we swap the cobbled streets for a canal boat tour of the old harbor. It is a weekend weighted towards culture, food and unhurried wandering, with water and gardens instead of wilderness. The city shifts with the seasons: flowers and outdoor cafes in spring and summer, twinkling lights, gløgg and Christmas markets in winter.

travels.title: New York 360°: discovering Manhattan, Brooklyn and Harlem
travels.description:
Where better to explore in the United States than New York City. We will discover the heart of the East Coast that always seems to be one step ahead of the rest of the world while maintaining a timeless charm.
We start with Manhattan, the beating heart of the city, where skyscrapers touch the clouds and the streets are busy with taxis, cars, bicycles, electric scooters, and people heading towards squares, parks, museums, art galleries, and shops. … Can we keep up? We'll stroll between Grand Central Station, the Flatiron Building, and the Empire State Building, and then Broadway to Times Square, Little Italy, Soho, and Chinatown. Then we'll head towards the Brooklyn Bridge and reach Dumbo, and then, we take the ferry to Ellis Island, passing the Statue of Liberty, a symbol of this multi-faceted city. A jump to Harlem, another to Central Park, and then the last one to Ground Zero, a true symbol of the city's rebirth: where an unearthly silence reigns. We will admire the Pools and the Freedom Tower, which soars high at 541 meters, remembering that New York is always ready to get back on its feet, despite whatever is thrown its way.

travels.title: Patagonia: Hiking Torres del Paine to Ushuaia at the End of the World
travels.shortDescription: 13 days, two countries, and a dream called Patagonia: trekking through the Andes, majestic glaciers, crossings in the Strait of Magellan, and the thrill of reaching Ushuaia, the end of the world. To top it off, Buenos Aires and its hot soul.
travels.description:
Patagonia is the dream destination for those who love adventure among unspoiled natural landscapes and soaring peaks. On this 13-day tour we travel from Argentina to Chile, crossing the Andes in their southernmost part. We will climb mountains, explore glaciers, walk among penguins and even reach the ends of the earth, lost in a bubble where time slows down and we can take a deep breath.
The tour begins in Buenos Aires before we fly south for some of the most iconic hikes in Argentina, near Fitz Roy and Cerro Torre, and on to the majestic Perito Moreno Glacier. Then we cross the Andes into Chile to trek in Torres del Paine National Park and travel on to Ushuaia, the southernmost city on the planet. We wrap up back in Buenos Aires, one of the great cities in the world.

travels.title: Madagascar 360°: Beach, jungle, baobabs, lemurs and chameleons
travels.description:
Madagascar – the 8th continent – a land of dreams and incredible diversity! There are countless reasons to visit Madagascar, but few are as captivating as the ring-tailed lemur, famous for its striking black-and-white striped tail. Yet, this island offers so much more. In the vibrant capital of Antananarivo, you’ll be greeted with the warm hospitality of the Malagasy people.
The landscapes of Madagascar are astonishingly varied – from the lush rainforests of Ranomafana National Park to the arid deserts and dramatic gorges of Isalo National Park. Another unmissable gem is the enchanting Reniala Reserve, where towering baobab trees, also known as monkey bread trees, stretch skyward like colossal bottles. Down south, in Mangily, crystal-clear waters invite us to snorkel, while pristine white sandy beaches provide the perfect spot to relax after our adventures.
“I like to move it, move it!” So, what are we waiting for? Let’s set off and explore the wonders of Madagascar!

travels.shortDescription: South Africa is a trip that changes you: 13 days between wild oceans, vibrant cities, and primal nature. From Cape Town to Johannesburg, passing through the Cape of Good Hope and Kruger, in search of the Big Five on safari.
travels.description:
Ready for a road trip like never before? This tour of South Africa is exactly that! In 13 days we explore the southernmost region of the African continent, from its complex history to the breathtaking natural beauty of these lands. Get ready for fun and, most of all, adventure!
We start from Cape Town, one of the three (yup, three!) capital cities, and head to Johannesburg along the coast, from Cape of Good Hope to Plettenberg Bay and Port Elizabeth. We dive into the cultures and traditions of the big cities, then into the wild nature of the African bush. To top it all off, a game drive in Kruger National Park to spot the Big Five: leopards, lions, buffalos, rhinos and elephants!

travels.title: Riga Weekend: Sauna Rituals & Underground Vibes
travels.description:
Join us for a weekend in Riga exploring Nordic rituals, underground clubs, and Baltic vibes.
This isn't just a classic sightseeing trip with rushing between monuments or hurried visits. You come here to live the city like the locals do, immersing yourself in its raw, creative, and surprisingly welcoming atmosphere.
Between Nordic coffee culture, traditional saunas overlooking the lake, and techno nights in old converted industrial spaces, this trip is designed for those who want to truly break free from routine and let themselves be carried away by an intense, authentic experience shared with the group.
The highlight? An authentic ritual sauna: 90 degrees that melt away your thoughts, birch branches perfuming the air, a plunge into the icy lake that awakens every cell in your body, and finally, hot herbal teas sipped by the fire, as the silence of the forest falls outside.
If you've never done an ice plunge after a sauna... this weekend could genuinely change your life (or at least your nervous system).

travels.title: South Korea 360°: Between Modernity And Tradition
travels.shortDescription: Discover South Korea between high-tech Seoul and ancient palaces, Andong with its hanok, Gyeongju temples, Busan beaches, and K-pop. Street food, markets, and selfies at N Seoul Tower: adventure, culture, and fun guaranteed!
travels.description:
South Korea is getting on the bucket list of every real traveller, so it should also be on your list of countries to visit at least once in a lifetime. Its culture and traditions remain intact despite its great openness to all things modern. We will see immense metropolises such as Seoul and Busan, but we will also find small oases of peace where time seems to stand still, as in the village of Andong or among the temples of Gyeongju.
Our journey begins in one of the world's most beautiful capitals, Seoul! From the majestic Changdeokgung Palace to the picturesque Bukchon Hanok district, here we will have our first impact with modern Korean culture. Immediately, however, we will leave the big city to visit a typical village in Andong, famous for its old hanok houses: here we will have a traditional lunch and learn the ancient paper colouring artcraft. We will then move on to Gyeongju to admire the historic temples, enjoy the beautiful beaches of Busan, visit typical markets and discover Yonggungsa, one of the most beautiful temples in all of Asia! We will finally return to Seoul, where we still have plenty of things to do: from Gwangjang Market to K-pop culture on Insadong Street, from Dongdaemun Design Plaza to the view we will enjoy from the spectacular N Seoul Tower! After so many adventures we will by now be experts in a culture that is so far removed from our own but at the same time beckons us with its timeless charm... are we moving here then?

travels.title: Philippines 360°: Bohol's Tarsiers, Palawan & a Night Under the Stars
travels.shortDescription: The trip to the Philippines you’ve always dreamed of. Explore the beaches of Bohol, the Chocolate Hills, and tarsiers. Discover the underground river of Palawan, the paradise of El Nido, and the Kayangan and Barracuda lakes in Coron. You’re welcome.
travels.description:
A tropical paradise of crystal-clear seas, lush jungle and postcard-perfect islands: on this trip we explore two of the archipelago's most captivating areas. We begin in Bohol, with pristine white beaches, turquoise waters and the famous Chocolate Hills, where we can spot tarsiers, the small primates that inhabit the island.
In Palawan we cross the world's longest underground river, discover lakes and lagoons, relax on tropical beaches and dive into crystal-clear waters. Between snorkeling, island hopping and breathtaking sunsets, we move through Port Barton and San Vicente to El Nido, the most iconic face of the Philippines, with hidden lagoons and limestone cliffs. The finale? Daracotan Island: a small, remote island where we sleep in tents overlooking the sea, facing a sunken shipwreck. If you love adventure, the sea and nature, this trip is for you!

travels.title: Budapest Weekend: The Pearl of the East
travels.shortDescription: Budapest in a weekend? Let’s take a boat tour, between castles, hot thermal baths, and its neighborhoods full of lights and pubs. Pest, Buda, Danube: history, street food, and guaranteed laughs. Come get lost with us in the coolest city in the East!
travels.description: In just one weekend, we want to show you Budapest, Hungary's capital – a stunning and captivating city, also known as “the Paris of the East”. We'll marvel at incredible monuments, and wander streets adorned with colourful lights reflecting on the waters of the river Danube. Thanks to local guides, we'll discover that Buda is the more historic centre, characterised by ancient palaces, castles, churches, monuments, and the famous Royal Castle, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Pest, on the other hand, is the more modern and lively part, home to key attractions like the Parliament and the Jewish Quarter with its hip ruin bars/hostels, a prime spot for weekend parties. Of course, we can’t miss a boat tour to see the city from the Danube! Between history, nightlife, and iconic experiences, this weekend is all about discovering Budapest from every angle — including a well-deserved soak in its famous thermal baths.

travels.title: Zagreb Weekend: the vibrant city and the Plitvice Lakes
travels.description:
Get ready for an unforgettable weekend that blends urban charm and natural wonder into one magnificent trip. Our adventure kicks off in Zagreb, Croatia's vibrant capital, a city with a historic heart and a modern soul. We'll dive into the Upper Town (Gornji Grad), where every alleyway tells a story, admiring the majestic Cathedral. We'll get lost in the authentic, lively atmosphere of the Dolac Market, a whirlwind of colours and scents that teases the senses. The Lower Town (Donji Grad) will welcome us with wide boulevards and manicured parks, like the Lenuci Horseshoe, framing magnificent Art Nouveau buildings.
Every corner hides the true beating heart of Zagreb's social life, offering a perfect balance of history, modern art, and a buzzing nightlife.
After fully soaking up the city's vibe, we'll get ready for a breathtaking change of scenery.
A short distance away, Plitvice Lakes welcome us with a paradise of crystal-clear water, ancient forests, and hand-painted-like waterfalls. We'll wander along the park's wooden boardwalks, a UNESCO World Heritage site. The paths will guide us through 16 lakes in emerald and turquoise hues, connected by countless, gushing waterfalls.
Every turn will reveal a new perspective, a new rush of water, a new glimpse of untouched nature. It will be a visual and sensory experience that will leave us breathless, a memory we'll always cherish, and confirmation that Croatia truly offers the best of both its urban soul and its wild heart.

travels.title: Colombia 360°: Bogotá, Medellín, Cartagena, and the Wonders of Tayrona Park
travels.shortDescription: Explore the many faces of Colombia: from vibrant Bogotá to the coffee of Salento and the palms of the Cocora Valley. Discover the rebirth of Medellín, the nature of Tayrona, and the colonial magic of Cartagena, for a deep dive into Colombian culture.
travels.description:
A single trip to Colombia may not be enough to uncover the countless wonders of this vibrant South American country, which boasts four distinct climate zones and a rich tapestry of cultural and territorial diversity. This journey will aim to delve into the true soul of Colombia, exploring its many facets—from the bustling big cities like Bogotá and Medellín, to the charming Andean pueblos, and the colonial enchantment of Cartagena de Indias.
The adventure begins in Bogotá, the capital, before diving into Colombia’s breathtaking natural landscapes in Salento, where we’ll learn about the art of coffee production and walk among the majestic tallest palm trees in the world in the Cocora Valley. From there, we return to the city and head to Medellín, discovering how Comuna 13 transformed itself into a powerful symbol of rebirth after years of hardship. Next, we venture to the sea, starting with the stunning Tayrona National Park, a spectacular natural haven, before reaching the Caribbean coast in Cartagena and the Islas del Rosario. Here, we’ll immerse ourselves fully in Colombian culture, embraced by the music, vivid colors, and warm smiles that define this extraordinary country.

travels.title: Puerto Rico: Rainforest, White Sand & the Bioluminiscent bay
travels.description:
What’s better than starting your Caribbean adventure on the enchanting island of Puerto Rico? A destination where tropical rhythm, Latin passion, and North American energy blend into one unforgettable experience.
Our journey begins in San Juan, a colorful capital alive with music, street art, and a vibrant cultural mix. From there, we’ll head deep into the lush El Yunque National Forest—the only tropical rainforest in the U.S.—where waterfalls, trails, and wild beauty create the perfect playground for explorers.
Next, we sail to Culebrita, a pristine island crowned by the world-famous Flamenco Beach, often ranked among the most beautiful on Earth. Down south, the surreal pink salt flats of Cabo Rojo await, glowing like a dream against the turquoise sea.
We’ll kayak through bioluminescent bays, spot manatees near tranquil mangroves, and—if the season is right—watch whales breach off the western coast. For thrill-seekers, surfing in Rincón and sunset drinks at Crash Boat Beach bring the perfect mix of adrenaline and chill. Before returning to San Juan, we’ll visit the breathtaking Window Cave (Cueva Ventana) for one final view to remember.
This isn’t just a trip—it’s an adventure for the soul. You’ll make new friends, live unforgettable moments, and fall in love with the natural and cultural magic of Puerto Rico — the island that has it all.

travels.title: Guatemala and Belize: Volcanoes, Ruins, and Caribbean Vibes
travels.description:
Guatemala, the land of eternal spring, is undoubtedly the most beautiful country in Central America, with its greatest cultural and natural diversity. During this trip, we will visit one of the most beautiful colonial cities in the world: Antigua Guatemala. Have you ever climbed an erupting volcano, slept at the summit, and witnessed the massive explosions up close? Well, this will be your chance to experience a magical adventure! We will visit colourful markets and villages and discover why Guatemala is culturally diverse. To do this, we will head to Lake Atitlán, a lake surrounded by 3 volcanoes and 12 villages. Here, we will learn about many traditions, hear new languages, and taste dishes that only exist in Guatemala—a true delight. We will venture into the small Guatemalan Amazon and spend time with a Garifuna community, the only
Caribbean-origin community in Guatemala. We will finish our journey through Guatemala in Tikal, the largest and most important Mayan complex in the world. Its pyramids are a marvel! We will then move on to Belize. Here, we will explore caves and float along the river in a tube. To end the trip, we will spend our last two days on Caye Caulker and visit the second-largest reef in the world. With that, we will say goodbye and return to England with countless memories and unforgettable experiences.

travels.title: Cape Verde Beach Life: Sal Island
travels.shortDescription: Paradise is here: discover Sal, Cape Verde, with its golden beaches and perfect climate! We’ll relax in Santa Maria, explore the Espargos market, admire the sharks at Baía dos Tubarões, and float in the unique Pedra de Lume salt pans.
travels.description:
Sal Island is one of the islands in the Cape Verde archipelago, located in the Atlantic Ocean off the northwest coast of Africa. While its beauty, warm climate, and golden sand beaches often draw comparisons to the Caribbean, Sal Island is firmly on the African continent. It's known for its spectacular coastline, water sports, diverse marine life, and unique local culture. On this trip, we'll unwind on the golden beaches of Santa Maria, swim in crystal-clear waters, and soak up the sun. We'll venture out to explore the authentic local culture, visiting the island's capital, Espargos, where we'll check out the colorful market and sample delicious traditional cuisine at local restaurants. You'll also explore Baía dos Tubarões, home to harmless sharks, and discover how island life intertwines with the ocean.
From the majestic Baía da Murdeira to Mount Leão and the Buracona rock formation with its stunning Blue Eye, every day will be packed with surprises. We'll venture inland to visit oases, dunes, and picturesque villages, where we'll try local fruits and immerse ourselves in rural life. Plus, you can float in the salt pans of Pedra de Lume – a truly unique experience. This eight-day journey blends beach relaxation with cultural and natural adventures in a little slice of paradise.

travels.title: Andalusia Weekend: Malaga and the Caminito del Rey
travels.shortDescription: Andalusia is a mix of emotions: suspended steps on the legendary Caminito del Rey, between dizzying gorges and breathtaking views, then Malaga captures you with its blend of history, art, sea, and tapas. An intense weekend of adrenaline, culture, and sun.
travels.description:
Andalusia is often called the most beautiful region in all of Spain, and we couldn't agree more! This weekend, we'll explore the wildest and most authentic side of Andalusia, dedicating ourselves to the famous Caminito del Rey. It's a unique adventure that blends breathtaking nature, history, and adrenaline. Not far from Malaga, this incredible path, suspended along the gorges of the Guadalhorce River, promises unforgettable thrills. Once used as a passage for dam workers, the Caminito is now one of Europe's most famous hikes, thanks to its sheer trails and spectacular views that open up at every step.
After crossing vertiginous walkways and suspension bridges, we'll head back to Malaga, a vibrant city that mixes historical charm with modernity. Known as the birthplace of Picasso, it boasts numerous museums, like the Picasso Museum Malaga, and historical monuments, such as the Alcazaba and Gibralfaro Castle. The city is also famous for its golden beaches, mild climate, and gastronomy, including tapas and olive oil. Ready to go? Vamos!

travels.title: Istanbul Express: From Ancient Mosques to Vibrant Streets
travels.shortDescription: Discover Istanbul, a bridge between East and West: explore the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, taste spicy street food and sweet Turkish treats. We think you’ll fall in love with Turkey, and yes, you’ll probably want to come back.
travels.description:
Istanbul, a city bridging two worlds, connects West and East, uniting two continents not just symbolically but in the daily lives of its people.
The city's complexity is striking—truly a "collection of many cities." Its architecture and social landscape shift dramatically within mere meters, from Taksim to Kasımpaşa or Sultanahmet to Kadırga, revealing vastly different realities.
Both the European and Asian sides showcase a mix of conservative and modern neighbourhoods, like Beyoğlu and Kadıköy, historic sites like Sultanahmet and Üsküdar, bustling shopping areas, and religiously diverse quarters like Fener and Balat. Picturesque villages line the Bosphorus.
In our five-day journey, we'll explore Istanbul's many faces—from the Blue Mosque to Hagia Sophia, vibrant neighborhoods, lively markets, and the flavors of street food and sweet Turkish delights.
This trip leaves us with a taste of Türkiye and a desire to return and dive deeper into this world among worlds.

travels.shortDescription: Ready to drive along the Australian East Coast? From Noosa to Sydney, with kangaroos on the beach, Whitsundays, and Cairns, this is a mix of adrenaline and breathtaking nature. The road trip we’ll always remember!

A road trip along Australia’s East Coast: we kick off in Brisbane, drive all the way to Cairns and fly to Sydney for the finale. From the laid-back waves of Noosa to the red-dusted roads around Rockhampton, we move from lush rainforests to dazzling coral reefs, from endless highways to sunsets straight off a postcard.
We’ll find silence in the wild beauty of Cape Hillsborough, where kangaroos hop across the beach, and the thrill of sailing around the Whitsundays aboard our boat to the Whitsunday Islands. Then a tropical escape to Cairns before bidding farewell in vibrant Sydney. Backpack packed? Let’s hit the road!

travels.title: Ecuador 360°: the Amazon, the Andes & Snorkeling the Galapagos Islands
travels.shortDescription: Live the adventure of all adventures, from the Amazon to the legendary Galapagos. Explore Quito, the Amazon rainforest, Baños, and the Cotopaxi Park, then fly to Santa Cruz, Isabela, and San Cristobal, discovering extraordinary cultures.
travels.description:
Two weeks from the Amazon to the legendary Galapagos: the adventure of a lifetime and a dream for all nature lovers. We begin in Quito, rich in history and vibrant culture, then venture into the Amazon rainforest, stop in Baños de Agua Santa, a thermal paradise in the Andes, and conquer Cotopaxi National Park, home to one of the largest active volcanoes in the world.
From the mainland we fly to the Galapagos, an enchanting UNESCO World Heritage site teeming with extraordinary wildlife found nowhere else. We explore the volcanic islands of Santa Cruz, Isabela and San Cristobal, with pristine beaches, wild animals and breathtaking scenery. Add Ecuador's rich history, vibrant music and warm people, and you get a true 360° experience!

We see the Taj Mahal, one of the seven wonders of the modern world and the treasure of Agra, at dawn, then Jaipur, the Pink City of sandstone facades and maharaja palaces, with its Amber Fort. travels.title: Canadian Rockies: Northern Lights Winter Quest
travels.description:
Embark on an extraordinary nine-day winter expedition through the majestic heart of the Canadian Rockies, where the season transforms the rugged landscape into a serene, frozen masterpiece. This carefully curated journey invites you to explore the legendary territories of Banff, Lake Louise, and Jasper, offering a peaceful and rejuvenating perspective found only amidst towering snow-capped peaks and the profound, crystalline stillness of the northern wilderness.
Beyond the breathtaking alpine scenery, this itinerary offers a rare bridge to the past, connecting you with the cultural soul of Alberta at the province’s premier Métis cultural interpretive centre. Here, you will be welcomed into a world of vibrant traditions and ancestral wisdom. Through immersive storytelling and authentic engagement, you will gain deep insights into the enduring heritage and resilient spirit of the Métis people, enriching your travel experience with a layer of profound human history.
Your adventure is filled with iconic highlights designed to showcase the best of the Great White North. You will traverse the world-renowned Icefields Parkway, a route celebrated globally for its dramatic glaciers and frozen turquoise lakes. Along the way, keep a watchful eye for elusive wildlife, such as elk and bighorn sheep, roaming through their winter habitats. As night falls, the expedition turns toward the heavens for the magical pursuit of the Northern Lights, seeking the ethereal glow of the aurora borealis in the dark-sky preserves. Escape the crowds on this authentic journey through untamed nature and rich culture, celebrating winter in its purest form.

travels.title: Balkan Christmas Markets: Ljubljana, Lake Bled & Zagreb
travels.description: Five festive days across two capital cities: Slovenia and Croatia's Christmas markets, from the fairy-tale lights of Ljubljana to the buzzing celebrations of Zagreb. We open in Ljubljana's Old Town, wandering festive stalls strung with lights along the riverbank, warming up with mulled wine and local delicacies like kranjska klobasa and potica. Day two is a day trip to Lake Bled, complete with Bled Castle perched above the water, the famous cream cake and lakeside markets, capped off with a festive river cruise back in the capital. On day three we head over to Zagreb, diving into Croatian food with a food tour and our first evening at Zagreb Advent, widely regarded as one of Europe's best Christmas markets, with its squares full of stalls, mulled wine bars and twinkling lights. On day four we take a trip to the WWII Tunnels, and a ride on the funicular lead into a street-food and craft-beer crawl through the city's lively food scene, plus more Advent markets and an evening of ice skating beneath the lights of Ban Jelačić Square.

travels.description:
Our group trip to Uzbekistan takes us to the land of "A Thousand and One Nights": ancient stories, desert adventures and a touch of excitement, with local train rides and an overnight stay in a traditional yurt. From picturesque oases and bustling bazaars to charming tea houses, sacred sites and Soviet-era palaces, this organized tour of Uzbekistan offers a timeless allure.
We explore a section of the legendary Silk Road, the historic trade route that connected Beijing to the Mediterranean, the most vital link for goods between China and the Western world. From the ancient city of Khiva to Bukhara and Samarkand, the capital of Tamerlane's empire, and on to modern Tashkent. Ready to uncover this fascinating corner of the world?

With imposing baobabs, vast savannahs, and the majestic Big Five, the experience promises to be nothing short of mesmerizing. We'll bid farewell to civilization in Arusha and be immersed in the primitive charm of Tarangire and Serengeti National Parks, where a stroke of luck could reward us with the sight of the wildebeest and zebra migration. We'll then descend into the heart of Ngorongoro crater and search for the king of the savannah, while a visit to Lake Eyasi brings an encounter with the Hedzabe tribe who still live by hunting, just like their ancestors 10,000 years ago. As we prepare for nights under the starry sky, we'll embrace the endless landscapes and the unexpected encounters, all the while knowing that the famous "sickness for Africa" will follow us when it's time to bid Tanzania farewell.

travels.title: Tunis Weekend: between history, culture, and flavours of Africa
travels.shortDescription: A journey through the most authentic Tunisia. Red dunes, vibrant bazaars, ruins of Carthage to explore, and Berber villages to discover. Between jeeps, camels, and fiery sunsets, every step is a breathtaking adventure.
travels.description:
Tunisia often conjures up images of sunny beaches and fancy resorts, but there’s so much more to uncover in this captivating land. Beyond the usual tourist trails lies a country brimming with history, culture, and breathtaking landscapes – a real treasure for those craving an authentic travel experience. Tunisia is a crossroads of influences, a mosaic of cultures that have left their mark over the centuries. Berbers, Arabs, Romans, French… each has left an indelible trace, creating a unique blend of traditions, architecture, and customs. Just a stone's throw from the capital, Tunis, lie the ruins of Carthage, the ancient Phoenician city that rivalled Rome, destroyed and later rebuilt by the Romans. Here, we marvel at the remnants of ancient temples, thermal baths, and amphitheatres, testaments to a glorious past.
But Tunisia isn't just about ancient history. Traces of French colonialism are still visible throughout the country, influencing language, cuisine, and architecture. And then there are the Berber traditions, still alive among the southern tribes, which might make you feel like you've stepped onto a Star Wars movie set. Tunisia is a country just waiting to be discovered, with its hospitable people, delicious food, and magical atmosphere.

travels.title: Sofia Weekend: Balkan Bites & Hidden Heritage
travels.description:
Discover the ultimate hidden gem of the Balkans! Sofia is a captivating city where over 2,000 years of complex history sit side-by-side in a fascinating architectural puzzle. From the ancient Roman ruins of Serdica—visible right in the heart of the city's metro stations—to imposing Soviet-era monuments and the breathtaking, glittering gold-domed Alexander Nevsky Cathedral, every street corner tells a unique story of transformation. Our weekend adventure is a perfect blend of deep heritage and high-octane modern energy. We’ll spend our time exploring the famous "Square of Religious Tolerance," a powerful and rare site where churches, mosques, and synagogues have coexisted peacefully for centuries within a single city block.
We’ll trade the mountain heights for the city’s vibrant urban soul, wandering through the artistic Shishman Street and uncovering hidden "secret bars" and craft beer spots known only to those who live here. Food is the heart of this journey; we’ll gather in traditional, cozy Mehanas to feast on authentic, flaky banitsa and refreshing shopska salad, always paired with a glass of local Rakia to get the social vibes flowing. Sofia is undeniably young, incredibly affordable, and remarkably welcoming—making it the ideal destination for an "off the beaten path" weekend adventure with a new group of friends looking for a European escape that feels truly different, gritty, and beautiful all at once. Come ready to explore, eat, and discover a side of Europe you never knew existed!

travels.title: Dominican Republic Expedition: an adventure between nature and Caribbean beaches
travels.description:
10 days, one island, endless Caribbean vibes.
 Get ready to experience the Dominican Republic from north to south, with the perfect mix of culture, nature, adventure, beach time, and nightlife. We’ll kick things off in Santo Domingo, soaking up the city’s energy as we explore the colorful Colonial Zone and discover hidden cenotes.
Then we head to the stunning Samaná Peninsula, where tropical landscapes, the iconic El Limón waterfall, and the beautiful beaches of Las Galeras are waiting for us. We’ll also stop in lively Las Terrenas, where we’ll dive into the local vibe and learn the moves with a fun merengue and bachata class. And because this trip is anything but ordinary, we’ll add an ATV adventure through some of the island’s most incredible scenery.
Next up: Punta Cana, with its white sand, turquoise water, and a night out at the legendary Coco Bongo. Then it’s time to slow things down in beautiful Bayahibe, where we’ll wrap up the trip with beach lunches, snorkeling, and a dreamy day on Saona Island, surrounded by those postcard-perfect Caribbean views.
This is the kind of trip you book for the destination and remember for the people, the laughs, and all the unexpected moments along the way.
